description: Build feed detail slide-out panel in the frontend at Projects/agent-os-demo-pages/. When a feed item is clicked, a right-side panel (55% width) slides out showing: (1) DELEGATION TREE — Goal→Mission→Plan→Pipeline→Task hierarchy with each level clickable, showing inline progress %. Use /api/feed/:id enriched response. (2) DELEGATED BY — chain showing which agent delegated to which. (3) AGENT STATUS — current state, tasks today. (4) WHAT IT DID — full description with topic tags. (5) ARTIFACTS — files produced, clickable. (6) TASK TIMELINE — chronological events for this task with 'you are here' marker. (7) VAULT CONNECTIONS — linked notes from obsidian vault. (8) SIBLING TASKS — other tasks in same mission with status. (9) WHAT'S NEXT — unblocked downstream tasks. (10) QUICK NAV — buttons linking to Mission View, Pipeline View, Vault, Agent Profile. Panel must work on both agent-os-demo-pages AND be portable to frontend-layer later. Use /api/feed, /api/agents, /api/queue endpoints.
